myth_urdu: رات کو فون چارج کرنا بیٹری خراب کرتا ہے
truth_urdu: جدید فون اوور چارجنگ سے محفوظ ہیں
explanation: Modern smartphones stop charging at 100% - the circuit cuts power automatically. Battery degradation is more about heat and charge cycles than overnight charging.

myth_urdu: انکوگنیٹو موڈ میں کوئی ٹریک نہیں کر سکتا
myth_english: Incognito mode makes you invisible online
truth_urdu: صرف براؤزر ہسٹری چھپتی ہے - آئی ایس پی اور ویب سائٹس دیکھ سکتے ہیں
truth_english: Only browser history is hidden - ISP and websites can still see you
explanation: Incognito only prevents local history. Your internet provider your employer and websites can still track you. For real privacy you need a VPN.

truth_urdu: پروسیسر اور سافٹ ویئر زیادہ اہم ہیں
truth_english: Processor and software optimization matter more
explanation: 8GB RAM phone with bad processor will be slower than 4GB RAM phone with good processor. RAM only helps with multitasking not overall speed.

truth_urdu: میک بھی وائرس کا شکار ہو سکتے ہیں
explanation: Macs are less targeted because fewer people use them but malware exists for macOS. Apple has built-in protection but you still need to be careful.

myth_urdu: 5G سے صحت کے مسائل ہوتے ہیں
truth_english: 5G radio waves are safe within guidelines
explanation: 5G uses non-ionizing radiation like WiFi and 4G. Hundreds of studies show no health effects at normal exposure levels. This is a debunked conspiracy.

myth_urdu: فون بند کرنا بیٹری کے لیے اچھا ہے
myth_english: Turning phone off saves battery life
truth_urdu: ریسٹارٹ بہتر ہے مکمل بند کرنے سے
truth_english: Restarting is better than shutting down
explanation: Turning phone off and on uses more battery than sleep mode. Better to restart weekly to clear memory. Modern phones are designed to stay on.

myth_urdu: پبلک وائی فائی سے بینکنگ محفوظ ہے VPN سے
myth_english: VPN makes public WiFi banking safe
explanation: VPN encrypts your connection but sophisticated attacks can still occur. Best practice is to avoid sensitive transactions on public WiFi entirely or use mobile data.

truth_urdu: سینسر سائز اور سافٹ ویئر زیادہ اہم ہیں
truth_english: Sensor size and software matter more
explanation: 12MP camera with large sensor beats 108MP camera with tiny sensor. Phone companies market megapixels because it's easy to understand but it's misleading.

myth_urdu: پرائیویٹ براؤزنگ ہیکرز سے بچاتی ہے
explanation: Private browsing doesn't add any security. It just doesn't save history locally. Hackers and malware work the same way in private mode.

myth_urdu: ایپ بند کرنے سے بیٹری بچتی ہے
truth_urdu: بار بار کھولنا بند کرنا زیادہ بیٹری استعمال کرتا ہے
truth_english: Opening and closing repeatedly uses more battery
explanation: Modern phones manage background apps efficiently. Force closing apps means they need to reload from scratch using more battery. Only close misbehaving apps.

myth_urdu: چارجر کی وائر سے ڈیٹا چوری ہو سکتا ہے
truth_urdu: صرف چارج اونلی کیبلز میں ڈیٹا وائرز نہیں ہوتے
truth_english: Only if cable has data wires and phone is unlocked
explanation: Juice jacking is real but rare. Use charge-only cables or USB data blockers at public stations. Keep phone locked while charging.

myth_urdu: فون ہر سال بدلنا ضروری ہے
myth_english: Need to replace phone every year
truth_english: Good phone lasts 3-4 years with care
explanation: Marketing makes you think you need new phone. Software updates keep phones useful for years. Budget phones may need earlier replacement.
